blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Panfilo Lacson on Tuesday reminded witnesses that the Senate Impeachment Court has the power to cite them for contempt if they make a “mockery” of its proceedings. This comes a day after the testimony of the first defense witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin, who was observed laughing during the interjections of senator-judges. “Rule 5 under Resolution No. 39… expressly grants the impeachment court the power to cite for contempt of the court anybody for that matter.
